CustomField.description: Required when SBI_Flag__c = TRUE. Documents the special billing instruction: what it is, which lines it applies to, start/end date, invoicing presentment requirements. Passed in IP-1 SBI payload.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required when Special Billing Instruction is flagged. Describe what the SBI is, which quote lines it applies to, the effective dates, and any invoicing presentment requirements.
CustomField.label: SBI Description
